title: coleostephus paludosus
intro: Coleostephus paludosus, commonly known as Marsh Cudweed, is a perennial herb belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae) and is native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from inflammation, skin conditions, and respiratory issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Coleostephus paludosus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which help in soothing skin irritations and reducing symptoms of respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
